1: basic container with a title
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note 提示
Hello, **world**!
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<p class="container-title">提示</p>
<p>Hello, <strong>world</strong>!</p>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

2: container without a title
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: warning
content
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container warning">
<p>content</p>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

3: title is parsed as inline elements
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note **bold** title
content
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<p class="container-title"><strong>bold</strong> title</p>
<p>content</p>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

4: nested containers
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note
outer
::: warning
inner
:::
after inner
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<p>outer</p>
<div class="container warning">
<p>inner</p>
</div>
<p>after inner</p>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

5: unclosed container is closed at EOF
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note
content

more
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<p>content</p>
<p>more</p>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

6: unclosed nested containers are closed at EOF
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note
::: warning
inner
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<div class="container warning">
<p>inner</p>
</div>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

7: list in a container
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note
- a
- b
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<ul>
<li>a</li>
<li>b</li>
</ul>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

8: fenced code block in a container
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note
```go
:::
```
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<pre><code class="language-go">:::
</code></pre>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

9: blockquote in a container
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note
> quote
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<blockquote>
<p>quote</p>
</blockquote>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

10: indented code block in a container
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note
    :::
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<pre><code>:::
</code></pre>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

11: indented container-like line is an indented code block
//- - - - - - - - -//
    ::: note
//- - - - - - - - -//
<pre><code>::: note
</code></pre>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

12: container-like line in a fenced code block
//- - - - - - - - -//
```
::: note
:::
```
//- - - - - - - - -//
<pre><code>::: note
:::
</code></pre>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

13: a line of colons only is not a container
//- - - - - - - - -//
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>:::</p>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

14: container between lists
//- - - - - - - - -//
- item1
- item2

::: note
content
:::

- after
//- - - - - - - - -//
<ul>
<li>item1</li>
<li>item2</li>
</ul>
<div class="container note">
<p>content</p>
</div>
<ul>
<li>after</li>
</ul>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

15: container in a blockquote
//- - - - - - - - -//
> ::: note
> inside
> :::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<blockquote>
<div class="container note">
<p>inside</p>
</div>
</blockquote>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

16: container in a list item
//- - - - - - - - -//
- item
  ::: note
  inside
  :::
- next
//- - - - - - - - -//
<ul>
<li>item
<div class="container note">
<p>inside</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>next</li>
</ul>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

17: container interrupts a paragraph
//- - - - - - - - -//
text
::: note
content
:::
//- - - - - - - - -//
<p>text</p>
<div class="container note">
<p>content</p>
</div>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//

18: container followed by a fenced code block
//- - - - - - - - -//
::: note
content
:::

```
code
```
//- - - - - - - - -//
<div class="container note">
<p>content</p>
</div>
<pre><code>code
</code></pre>
//= = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = = =//
